scope: Production preview image waiting now uses accumulated visible time. Component and owned-browser resource validation only; native Safari background behavior and printing not signed off.
defect: Outer preview suspended its timeout while hidden but waitForPreviewImages exhausted 15 seconds of wall time, causing a false image timeout in background tabs.
behavior: Pause remaining image budget on hidden; resume without resetting; load, error and abort still settle immediately while hidden. Remove timer and visibility/load/error/abort listeners on completion.

verification.before: Two new visibility tests reproduce failure on prior product source; fourteen other image cases pass.
verification.after: 80 tests pass across image wait, preview controls and preview page; six new image cases included.
verification.browser: Five owned Chrome154 image request/decoding cases pass. document.hidden/visibilitychange controlled in test, not native tab visibility or Safari.
verification.lint: ESLint on changed application and test files passed
verification.manifest: Only one application file changed; old baseline check correctly fails, explicit new 174-file manifest check passes.

limitations: No PDF encoder changes or integration. Multilingual PDF copy and Safari non100% printing remain unresolved.
No native Safari background-tab or print test in this round.
Historical native and quota evidence retains its original candidate provenance; no whole-product completion claim.
